licence_stored: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (the fetcher prints 'CC-BY-SA' with no version; the library stores the versioned form, and data/kb/NOTICE.md lists the Half-Life Wiki as CC-BY-SA-3.0, as it does for its other Fandom wikis)
how_read: scripts/kb/fetch_wiki_live_pages.py --api https://half-life.fandom.com/api.php --titles <pages> --out build/wiki-live/halflife (page text as rendered by the wiki, link markup removed; every page was over 7,000 characters, so none is a failed read). Each line was written from a short list of facts taken from the page, not from the page's sentences. Every fragment quoted below was checked, by script, to appear word for word in the page text read at the revision named, inside the named part of the page (curly quotes read as straight). Each quote is marked with where it sits: only the wiki editors' own prose and bare rows of an infobox table (a number, a name) stand behind a line; no quote block, dossier, description box, achievement, journal or other game text of the game's own is used. The notes state facts about Half-Life 2 only: where a page mixes games (Half-Life, the episodes, Half-Life: Alyx), only the sentences or table rows that say Half-Life 2, or that the page gives for the base game's own parts, are used. Several pages (Headcrab, Zombie, Poison Zombie, Fast Zombie, SPAS-12, Barnacle) are cited by other notes besides their own, and each such use is named in that line's evidence.

lines.line: Summary: A small, weak parasite with 10 health and a 5-damage bite. It is a real nuisance in numbers, mostly because you stop noticing it while you deal with something bigger.

quoted: Standard Headcrabs do not pose much of a threat to Gordon on their own.
Focusing on the more dangerous enemies, the player might not notice Standard Headcrabs leaping at them.
The main threat that Headcrabs pose is their numbers.

lines.line: Weak points: Its underside: a crowbar swing at it while it leaps kills it in one hit, and gravity gun bursts are easy to land on it. It cannot swim, and drowns if it falls into deep water.

quoted: a crowbar to the Headcrab's underside while it is leaping will kill it in one swing
it is fairly simple to hit the Headcrab with Gravity Gun bursts
all headcrabs cannot swim and will drown if they fall into water which submerges them completely
drowning when entering water

lines.line: Looks like: A round, smooth, tan body on four legs, about two feet long, with a round mouth underneath.

quoted: They have round, smooth, tan-colored bodies and four legs
about two feet long from front leg to back
Under the body is a round, lipless mouth

lines.line: Tips: Keep moving when headcrabs are about. A pistol suits a few of them, the shotgun short to medium range, and the SMG a big group; one hand grenade can clear headcrabs and zombies together.

quoted: it is preferable to keep moving at all times when Headcrabs are present
In smaller groups, the 9mm Pistol is ideal against Headcrabs
the shotgun can easily replace its role in short to medium ranges
a weapon with a larger ammo capacity, such as the SMG, is a better choice
a Hand Grenade can be used to take a large group of Headcrabs and Zombies out in one grenade

lines.line: Tips: If poison headcrabs are mixed in, kill those first. A headcrab cannot hurt you while you are in a vehicle.

quoted: the Poison Headcrabs should be killed first
The Headcrabs in Half-Life 2 cannot attack the player if they are inside a vehicle.

lines.line: Summary: A lanky, very quick headcrab with the same 10 health and 5-damage bite as the ordinary kind. It can bite again sooner than the others, which adds up when several come at you.

quoted: Fast Headcrabs have the same amount of health as a standard headcrab.
Fast headcrabs deal the same amount of damage as the standard headcrab, but can attack consecutively faster than other headcrab variants due to their quick movements.

lines.line: Looks like: A slim body covered in wart-like bumps, on long, evenly sized legs that end in claws, with no fangs showing outside the mouth.

quoted: They possess a slimmer less weighted body with no visible fangs outside of their mouth cavity.
They possess wart-like bumps all throughout their skin.
their legs are much longer and uniform in length
These thin legs have elongated claws on each end

lines.line: Tips: It dies to anything that kills an ordinary headcrab, but its speed makes the crowbar and pistol harder to land. Shoot it from a distance; the MP7's fast fire and spread work well on one or a group.

quoted: the player can kill the fast headcrab with the weapons used to kill a headcrab
fast headcrabs are harder to kill than their cousins due to their quick movements which makes some surefire weapons like the crowbar or pistol harder to use
The player should take out the fast headcrab at a distance when they can.
Weapons such as the MP7 can be effective in taking down one or a group of fast headcrabs due to it's high rate of fire and spread.

lines.line: Tips: In dark places one may cling to the ceiling and drop on you, or when a light triggers it, so check overhead. When one gets close, back off or keep it in sight so you can kill it right away.

quoted: In dark areas, fast headcrabs can attach themselves to overhead surfaces where they will wait to drop down on unsuspecting prey or upon stimulus from a light source.
the player should try to regain distance or keep visual track of the fast headcrab as to kill it immediately

lines.line: Summary: A slow, dark headcrab with 35 health. Its bite drops you to 1 health at once; your suit's antidote then slowly brings you back up, a little short of where you were.

table_rows.label: Attacks
table_rows.value: Venomous bite (Drops the player's health to 1 instantly, which slowly regenerates)

quoted: A bite from a poison headcrab will invariably reduce the player's health to 1, after which the HEV Suit will administer an antidote that will slowly regenerate the player's health minus the headcrab's bite damage.
The poison headcrab is the slowest of the headcrabs in terms of movement

lines.line: Looks like: Dark skin and long, bristly legs with red joints crossed by a white band; the biggest of the headcrabs, with a bulky body.

quoted: The poison headcrab is identifiable by its dark skin and elongated legs.
It is the largest of the headcrab subspecies seen on Earth with a bulky body and thick long legs.
covered in bristles like its body
The skin around the joint is red in color, with a white band running across the joint itself.

lines.line: Tips: It is slow and rattles before it jumps, so sidestep; moving backwards can still get you bitten. It tends to hide, but its sounds give it away, so kill it before the other enemies.

quoted: poison headcrabs are slow to attack and will telegraph their movements
Avoid the attack by going sideways as moving backwards can still guarantee a hit from the headcrab.
It's better to take out poison headcrabs first before focusing on other enemies due to their venomous bite.
they are vocal creatures and will make themselves known with their distinct vocalizations
it will give off a distinct rattling sound before attacking head on
Poison headcrabs prefer to hide when they can as opposed to staying out in the open

lines.line: Tips: One shotgun blast at close range, one .357 shot at any range, or one crowbar hit kills it; a pistol takes many shots.

quoted: one shot at close range will kill a poison headcrab instantly
the .357 Magnum, which is a one-shot kill at any range
Poison headcrabs can also be killed with one hit from a crowbar.
poison headcrabs can take multiple shots and up to 10 on Hard difficulty

lines.line: Summary: The ordinary zombie: a person taken over by a headcrab, relentless and tougher than a normal human. It swings objects in its way at you, and some lie still among corpses and rise when you come close.

quoted: zombies showcase resilience and strength that are superior compared to normal humans
Upon sensing a threat, a zombie will move towards that threat with little regard to themselves or the damage they sustain.
Zombies created by the standard headcrab try and swing objects in their way towards a threat to damage it.
they will lie motionless on the ground as if they were a corpse, then awaken and move towards a threat that comes too close to them or upon taking damage to their body

lines.line: Weak points: The headcrab on its head: when it dies or comes off, the host dies too. Aim for the head; a double shotgun blast there is a guaranteed kill.

quoted: the host also invariably dies when their resident headcrab is detached or dies
When dealing with Zombies, the player should aim for the head to avoid fighting the Headcrab; a double shot is the guaranteed kill.

lines.line: Looks like: A rotting, decayed body whose hands have turned into claws, with a headcrab on its head.

quoted: share the same trait of extensive tissue decay in the body and the mutation of the digits in the hands into claws
A zombie is created when a headcrab succesfully latches onto a human host and pierces through their skull with its beak.
check if any still have headcrabs attached to their head

lines.line: Tips: A zombie does not notice fire, electricity or traps unless they block its way. Some corpses are not dead: a body with a headcrab still on its head may just be lying still, so shoot it in the head, or throw a grenade if you cannot kill it without waking it.

quoted: the zombie cannot perceive other forms of danger that can be harmful to itself such as fire or electricity
Other dangerous hazards such as man-made traps are also not perceived as long as they don't obstruct its movement.
This tactic was also used by Standard Zombies in Half-Life 2.
check if any still have headcrabs attached to their head, as this is a good sign the Zombie is merely playing dead
shoot them in the head with the Colt Python or Shotgun just in case
throw a grenade at them if the player is unable to kill them without waking the Zombie up

lines.line: Tips: The buzz of flies often gives a zombie away. A shotgun is a good choice against every kind, and a zombie that loses its legs can keep coming.

quoted: An often-overlooked effect that signals a Zombie's presence is the buzz of flies
The SPAS-12 is a good weapon to use when dealing with Zombies of any type
some zombies have also been showcased to survive physical trauma such as the loss of their lower halves

lines.line: Summary: A fast, agile zombie with 50 health that climbs, runs and leaps. Its leap hit does 10 and its double slash 6, and it often comes in packs of three to four.

quoted: Fast Zombies are extremely quick and agile, being able to climb, run, and jump faster and farther than a normal zombie.
they often travel in packs of three to four

lines.line: Weak points: Its head: aim there with the shotgun or the .357. Hit it in mid-leap and it dies on the spot; the crossbow suits that best.

quoted: use the shotgun or Colt Python and aim for the head
Shooting the Zombie as they leap can instantly kill them in mid-air.
It is recommended to use the Crossbow for this

lines.line: Looks like: No skin and few organs, so bone and muscle show, with long claws; it stands on two legs to slash but runs and climbs on all fours.

quoted: Fast Zombies have been stripped completely of their skin and most of their internal organs; bones and muscle tissue are clearly visible throughout the host's body.
Their claws are also much longer than Standard Zombies.
Fast Zombies stand on two legs while slashing with their claws or standing up, but move on all fours while running or climbing

lines.line: Tips: Alone it is weak, so the pack is the danger. Shoot it at medium range, where it struggles to get round to your side; cover stops its leap, and on a ladder it cannot attack you at all and gets stuck beneath you.

quoted: aren't particularly dangerous on their own because their attacks are fairly weak
Fast Zombies are actually much easier to hit at medium range, as it is harder for them to move quickly behind or to the side of the player
Hiding behind cover will prevent the Fast Zombie from using their leap attack
Fast Zombies cannot attack the player while on a ladder.
They will get stuck under the ladder, allowing the player to hack away at them with his Crowbar until they drop.

lines.line: Tips: Listen for its howl. On rooftops stay back from the edge: being startled off it costs fall damage. It climbs gutters that rattle as it comes, so shoot over the side before it reaches the top.

quoted: Fast Zombies can be detected by the distinct howling they tend to emit
the biggest threat is actually falling off by surprise when a Fast Zombie suddenly attacks, thus causing fall damage while the Zombie pursues
the player will hear a rattling beat, and the gutter will move side-to-side
Aim over the side of the building and shoot the Zombie before they reach the top.

lines.line: Summary: A bloated, slow zombie with 175 health and a 20-damage slash. It carries three poison headcrabs on its back and throws them at you before it fights hand to hand.

quoted: They are almost always seen carrying three additional Poison Headcrabs on their back.
A poison zombie will try to empty its load of poison headcrabs first before resorting to melee attacks.

lines.line: Weak points: Fire: set it alight and the headcrabs on its back burn with it. Kill it before it throws and those headcrabs die too, so a crossbow bolt into the ones on its back ends it early.

quoted: The most effective weapon against poison zombies is fire; when hit, the Zombie will set alight the Headcrabs as well.
When using the Crossbow against it, get away from the poison zombie and aim at the Headcrabs on its back. This way, the Poison Zombie should die without releasing its poison headcrabs.
if the player kills the Poison Zombie before it can "release" the Poison Headcrabs from its back, the headcrabs will also die.

lines.line: Looks like: Bloated and reddish-purple, hunched forward with its upper body at a right angle to its legs.

quoted: Poison zombies are bloated, reddish purple, slow-moving zombies.
The Poison Zombie has a heavily stooped posture
its torso forming a 90

lines.line: Tips: Set it alight with a propane tank or gas canister held in the gravity gun, then get under cover or away before it throws more headcrabs. Grenades or explosive barrels will not set it alight, but they do decent damage.

quoted: A very good tactic is to grab a propane tank or gas canister with the Gravity Gun, pop out of cover, light up the Zombie, and then take cover or leave the area before it throws more headcrabs.
cannot light the Poison Zombie up, it can inflict decent damage on it

lines.line: Tips: Up close, keep moving as you attack so the thrown headcrabs miss; one that lands drops you to 1 health, so do not swing the crowbar at them while other enemies are about. Once it has thrown all three it is little threat, and a pulse rifle energy ball destroys it outright.

quoted: At close range, move around while attacking to avoid being hit by the thrown headcrabs.
When a thrown poison headcrab comes into contact, health points will drop to 1
it is advised not to use the Crowbar against incoming thrown headcrabs, especially when being engaged by other enemies
The Zombie should be a minimal threat without the hitch-hiking poison headcrabs on its back
use its alternative fire on the Zombie, which will cause the Zombie to disintegrate

lines.line: Summary: A huge antlion with 500 health. It charges from afar and butts you up close: a running head smash does 20, a headbutt 10, and it can also fling objects at you.

quoted: If the target is some distance away, they will charge forward and try to ram their massive weight against a target.
the Guard may also fling these objects with great velocity towards a target

lines.line: Weak points: It turns slowly, so strafing keeps you clear of its attacks, and a charge that ends in a wall stuns it for a few seconds. It is a big target for the shotgun, which is extremely effective against it.

quoted: Its attacks can be easily avoided by strafing constantly as the Guard is slower when it is turning.
Luring it into smashing into walls will stun it for a few seconds, buying the attacker some time to shoot it.
the SPAS-12 is extremely effective against the Guard, as its big size makes it an easy target and thus absorbs the entirety of the shotgun's blast

lines.line: Looks like: About 8.6 feet tall, with a hard dark-red shell, bright blue feather-like growths down its back, and a bulky, beak-tipped head it uses as a battering ram.

quoted: Antlion Guards are considerably large (8.6 feet in height.) and powerful Antlions.
They have a hard carapace with a dark-red tint and radiant blue feather-like protrusions adorning their backs.
a robust center and a beak-like structure at the tip
charge forward using their head as a battering ram

lines.line: Tips: Its growls tell you an attack is coming. Soldier antlions that arrive with it can swarm and slow you, so clear the ones in your way while you watch where the guard is. High-damage weapons such as the crossbow and the RPG cut the fight short, and the MP7's grenade launcher is a good alternative.

quoted: Its distinctive growls can also cue the player as to when it is about to attack.
Be careful when the Guard spawns in with Antlion Soldiers, as they can easily swarm you and impede your movement.
Kill any that get in your way but keep track of the Guard.
High-damage weapons such as the Crossbow and the RPG can shorten the amount of time required to take one down.
Another good alternative is using the grenade launcher on with the MP7.

lines.line: Tips: Switching between weapons keeps the damage coming with no pause to reload. Explosive barrels, or a heavy object such as a car engine, thrown with the gravity gun hurt it and save ammo. A pulse rifle energy ball leaves it badly hurt but alive. If it throws something at you, dodge it, or catch it and send it back.

quoted: Cycling between weapons is a good way of dealing damage to a Guard continuously without pausing to reload
launching explosive barrels or weighty objects like a car engine using the Gravity Gun can also deal significant damage to a Guard while conserving ammo
The Pulse Rifle's secondary fire will not disintegrate the Guard, but will heavily damage it.
be prepared to avoid their projectile or catch it and counter-throw with the Gravity Gun

lines.line: Summary: A small flying drone with 25 health and spinning blades. It crashes into its target with no care for itself, and is deadliest in vents, sewers and other tight places, usually in a group.

quoted: They are programmed with very little concept of self-preservation, careening off walls and through objects in their single-minded pursuit of their target.
The Manhack's razor-sharp blades make them especially deadly in confined spaces such as alleyways, sewers, and small passages where they are most commonly deployed.
Manhacks rarely travel alone and are usually deployed in large groups.

lines.line: Looks like: Three blades spinning so fast they whir, and a single camera eye that glows red while it is active.

quoted: a flying, gyroscopic drone with three razor-sharp blades that constantly spin at extremely high speeds
Their spinning blades produce a high-pitched whirring sound, which is often an indicator of their proximity.
A single camera functions as the Manhack's eye, glowing red when the device is active.

lines.line: Tips: A few pistol or SMG rounds kill it, but it bounces around when hit; a shotgun or magnum shot kills it at once. Three crowbar hits destroy it, though that puts you next to its blades.

quoted: A few shots from a pistol or SMG can kill it.
they often bounce around after being hit which can make shooting one down not so straightforward unless using a weapon that can destroy them instantly in one shot like the shotgun or magnum revolver
a single hit will cause it to become disoriented and three will destroy it instantly. This is however risky as it involves getting in close range to the Manhack and it's blades.

lines.line: Tips: The gravity gun is highly effective, if not the most effective, weapon against them: pull one in and punt it into a wall to destroy it. Against several, use a fast-firing weapon like the SMG or pulse rifle, and deal with them quickly before they distract you from other threats.

quoted: The Gravity Gun is highly if not the most effective weapon against them in combat.
Manhacks can be pulled into the Gravity Gun's field after which they can be launched into walls or simply punted into one with the primary fire, which instantly destroys them.
using a weapon with a high rate of fire and high magazine like the SMG or Pulse Rifle can help to deal damage to multiple targets while keeping them at a distance
It is advised to deal with Manhacks quickly since their presence can often distract the player from other threats.

lines.line: Summary: A ceiling-hanging mouth with a sticky tongue that hauls up anything that touches it. It has 35 health here and crushes for 10 again and again; it kills other characters outright with a neck snap, but not you.

table_rows.label: Attacks / Weapons
table_rows.value: Neck snap (HL2) (instant kill to NPCs only)

lines.line: Weak points: The crowbar kills it in one hit, and it dies if it swallows poison. Set an explosive barrel alight at the right moment, while a barnacle is trying to eat it, and the blast can kill it, even several close together.

quoted: The Barnacles are weak against the crowbar, which in both games kills them in a single hit.
Barnacles cannot eat prey containing neurotoxins or any type of poison.
by setting alight an explosive barrel at the right moment, a player can kill a Barnacle attempting to eat it (or even several closely-attacked Barnacles)

lines.line: Looks like: A ceiling-hung mouth with two rows of sharp teeth and a long thin tongue that dangles down from it.

quoted: A Barnacle is little more than a large mouth full of two rows of sharp teeth, with a long string-like appendage dangling out of its maw.
Barnacles attach themselves to ceilings or the undersides of overhangs, from which they lower their sticky tongues.

lines.line: Tips: It takes a moment to tell food from junk and holds one thing at a time, so a tire, barrel or plank on its tongue lets you slip past.

quoted: In Half-Life 2, Barnacles take a few moments to differentiate between edible and inedible material.
objects such as tires, barrels or pieces of wood can be used to
it only grabs one thing at a time

lines.line: Tips: Four or five pistol shots kill it, and if it grabs you, you can usually kill it before it swallows you. Do not crowbar a high one: you take fall damage as well as its attack.

quoted: 4-5 shots from a 9mm pistol will kill them.
players who become ensnared by its tongue are usually able to kill them before being consumed
attacking a Barnacle which is high up with a crowbar is generally a bad idea, as the player will take fall damage as well as the Barnacle's attack

lines.line: Summary: A big Combine flyer that only explosives hurt: 3, 5 or 7 RPG hits on easy, normal and hard. It shoots your rockets out of the air, and the Combine often send two together.

quoted: Like most Synths, Gunships are invulnerable to small-arms fire and can only be damaged by explosives such as the RPG.
they will prioritize shooting down incoming projectiles over enemy hostiles
the Combine often deploy Gunships in pairs

lines.line: Weak points: Small arms do nothing; only explosives such as the RPG hurt it. A rocket coming in at its rear or side meets a blind spot, and once it has started shooting at one target it cannot switch, so send your rocket while it is busy with another.

quoted: Like most Synths, Gunships are invulnerable to small-arms fire and can only be damaged by explosives such as the RPG.
try to sneak the rocket through the rear or side arc on it's blindspot
the gunship cannot change targets in the middle of a firing cycle

lines.line: Looks like: A stubby round head and a wide body ending in a huge round rotor; green-brown camouflage with white splotches on top, white with teal underneath.

quoted: It has a round, stubby head with a body that extends wider to it's backside
the top of half of the Gunship has a camouflage pattern consisting of a green-brownish color mixed with white colored splotches
The underside is white with accents of teal

lines.line: Tips: Its cannon makes a thud just before it starts to fire, which is your warning. It shoots at a spot ahead of you before it hits you, so you have less time to reach cover.

quoted: Before firing, the Gunship's pulse cannon emits a mechanical thud-like sound, alerting the player that the Gunship is about to begin its firing cycle
Like Striders, Gunships will often fire ahead of the target before directly hitting it
giving a player less time to seek cover

lines.line: Tips: A rocket still in flight takes its attention from everything else, which buys you time when you must cross open ground to a rocket crate. In scripted fights such as the one at New Little Odessa it also fires at explosive barrels when you are near them, so keep clear of explosive barrels.

quoted: Gunships will always prioritize missiles in the air over any other target.

If the player needs to get across open ground to resupply, fire the rocket into the air and steer it around as long as possible while moving to the next spot of cover. The gunships will be entirely distracted by the missile
Gunships also tend to fire at explosive barrels when an enemy is near them (in scripted events, such as the battle at New Little Odessa)
the player should always keep distance from explosive barrels

lines.line: Summary: The Combine assault rifle: fully automatic, 30 shots a magazine, up to 90 carried, 8 damage a shot. Its second fire throws an energy ball (up to 3 carried) that kills a human-sized enemy outright.

table_rows.label: Damage
table_rows.value: 1000 per energy ball (instant death to human-sized enemies)

lines.line: Uses: A short to medium range all-rounder, better than the MP7 because each shot hits much harder. Best where ammo is plentiful, such as against Combine soldiers, whose dropped rifles hold far more ammo than their MP7s.

quoted: In most situations, the Pulse Rifle is better than the MP7, and is a good all-around automatic weapon.
the Pulse Rifle compensates with the much higher damage per shot
it is best used in situations where nearby ammo is plentiful - that is, when fighting Combine Soldiers as a rifle dropped gives much more ammo compared to the MP7

lines.line: Tips: Fire in short bursts: recoil is strong and the spread widens while you hold the trigger. It is most accurate standing still, so go for headshots.

quoted: The Pulse Rifle's recoil is strong.
The weapon's spread is much worse when firing the weapon in automatic mode, so firing it in short bursts is highly recommended
Take advantage of its high stationary accuracy and go for headshots if possible.

lines.line: Tips: Save the energy balls: one goes through a line of enemies and bounces round small rooms, but it breaks up in open sky and leaves about a second after the trigger. Only Overwatch Elites use them, and drop one when killed.

quoted: They are efficient on lined up enemies, since it goes through them all before it hits a wall.
Using it in small rooms is also efficient, since it bounces on the walls, floor and ceiling.
the projectile orb disintegrates upon flying out into open air
it takes about 1 second to launch an orb when the trigger is pulled
only Overwatch Elite are allowed to fire the Energy Balls. If the Overwatch Elite is killed, they will drop an Energy ball and the player can pick it up.

lines.line: Summary: A pump shotgun: 6 shells loaded, up to 30 carried. Primary fire uses one shell; secondary fire uses two for double the pellets, with a longer wait before the next shot.

quoted: The alternate fire mode fires double the amount of pellets in a larger, less tight spread and uses two shells, but has a longer delay between shots.

lines.line: Uses: Strongest up close; it loses punch with distance. Its primary fire is effective against weak enemies such as headcrabs and zombies, and it is decent against Combine soldiers up close. Antlions are big targets, so it is rated the best weapon against them, even from some way off; against an Antlion Guard it is very effective when other heavy weapons are unavailable.

quoted: The SPAS-12 is very effective at close range against most targets, but its effectiveness decreases significantly with range because its pellets spread more the farther they go.
The primary fire is effective against weak enemies, such as Headcrabs, Zombies, Houndeyes, Combine Soldiers and Vortigaunts.
The SPAS-12 is the most effective weapon against Antlions, even at some distance, due to their hitbox being large.
It's also very effective against Antlion Guards when other heavy weapons are unavailable.
makes the SPAS-12 a decent weapon at close range

lines.line: Tips: At medium range aim for the middle of the body, since the pellets spread; a point-blank headshot usually kills in one. Reload whenever you can, since an empty magazine takes much longer to refill; pressing fire stops a reload.

quoted: it is actually more effective to aim for the center-of-mass at medium ranges, as the pellets are more likely to hit the target
At close range, a point-blank headshot will, more often than not, result in a one-shot kill.
Reloading must be done as often as possible, as an empty SPAS-12 magazine takes much longer to reload than other weapons
The reloading process can be interrupted at any time by pressing the fire key.

lines.line: Tips: A box of shells gives 20 and two boxes refill an empty gun; boxes and supply crates are common. A gun found on the ground or dropped by a soldier gives a full 6. Father Grigori hands you your first one in the sixth chapter.

quoted: a box of shotgun shells restores 20 shells instead of 12 and is far more common to find
Two boxes of ammo can fully resupply an empty SPAS-12 with some shells to spare.
SPAS-12s found on the ground or dropped by Overwatch Soldiers supply a full magazine of 6 rounds.
a Supply Crate will give the player ammo for shotguns
In Half-Life 2, the SPAS-12 is first given to Freeman by Father Grigori in the sixth Half-Life 2 chapter

lines.line: Summary: A homemade sniper crossbow: one red-hot rebar bolt per shot, up to 10 carried, 100 damage (instant death to human-sized enemies). Secondary fire zooms in.

quoted: The primary trigger fires a bolt; the secondary trigger zooms in on targets
pieces of red-hot steel rebar about 12 inches (30 centimeters) long

lines.line: Uses: Long-range shots at high-value targets: Overwatch soldiers and Elites, Antlion Guards and Poison Zombies. It is wasted on headcrabs and manhacks.

quoted: Reserve crossbow bolts for high value targets such as Overwatch Soldiers, Overwatch Elites, Antlion Guards, Poison Zombies, and Hunters.
Small, weak targets, such as Manhacks and Headcrabs should not be fired upon with the crossbow

lines.line: Tips: Bolts fly slowly and drop over distance, so aim a little above a far target and lead a moving one. They ricochet off a floor or wall hit at a shallow angle.

quoted: Users firing over long distances must account for this drop by aiming slightly above the target.
Aim both above and in front of the target to land the hit.
the bolt will ricochet if it hits a floor or wall at a shallow angle

lines.line: Tips: Do not use it on vehicles (the bolt bounces off), on more than one antlion, or on a Strider. It can fire underwater, but the bolt's path is unpredictable there. You first find it next to a dead rebel on Highway 17.

quoted: Vehicles will have the rebar bounce off it; moreover, its use is the epitome of futility against more than one Antlion, and is suicidal against Striders.
The crossbow is one of only two ranged weapons capable of firing underwater. However, the bolt's course once it starts traveling through the water gets very unpredictable.
In Half-Life 2, the Crossbow is first discovered next to the rotten body of a Resistance fighter overlooking an Overwatch outpost in the level Highway 17

lines.line: Summary: Health kits restore a fixed 25 health on every difficulty, and they are your main way of healing in this game. Vials are the smaller version, worth 10.

quoted: In Half-Life 2, healthkits always give 25 health points, regardless of the difficulty setting, making them the main source of healing throughout the game
Healthvials are smaller than healthkits, and give 10 health points.

lines.line: Uses: Supply crates hold kits, especially far from Combine territory, because wall chargers are rarer and mostly inside it. Dead Civil Protection officers and Overwatch soldiers often drop vials.

quoted: as they are much more common and widely dispersed than health chargers, which are often only found in Combine-controlled areas
Healthkits are also found more prolifically in supply crates in more remote areas
They are often dropped by Civil Protection officers and Overwatch Soldiers upon their death.

lines.line: Tips: A crate or drop is more likely to hold healing when your health is low.

quoted: they're more likely to be given in supply crates when the player's health is low
They are more likely to drop when the player's health is low.

lines.line: Tips: Rebels who follow you take kits to heal themselves; to give one a kit, pick a kit up and stand in front of that rebel.

quoted: Rebels in a squad following the player may pick up medkits to heal themselves or save them to be used later on injured rebels.
The player can also give a medkit to the squad members by picking up one and standing in front of them.

lines.line: Summary: Wall chargers refill your health or your suit power, but each holds only a limited amount. Press the use key while standing near one; it empties as you draw from it and cuts off when it is dry or you are full.

quoted: Health and HEV Suit Chargers are wall-mounted devices that give a limited amount of health and power.
The chargers can be used by staying near them and pressing the USE key.
Whilst being used, their power drains and eventually they will stop healing or charging.
In Half-Life 2 and Half-Life: Source they will also stop when the player reaches full health or power.

lines.line: Uses: Health chargers heal you; suit chargers refill suit power, still the main source of it because batteries are less common. Health kits are the main healing item, while chargers are common inside City 17.

quoted: In Half-Life 2, however, medkits have become the primary healing item, giving 25 health points.
whereas chargers are common within City 17
The HEV charger is still the primary source of power, due to batteries being comparatively uncommon.

lines.line: Tips: A health charger has a blue line that shrinks as its store is used up. Away from Combine areas, such as the Wasteland, expect health kits rather than chargers.

quoted: The Half-Life 2 variant has a blue line that gets smaller as more supplies are used up
Medkits are also considerably more common in Wasteland areas outside of Combine control
